snippet.title: Warlord: Awaji Main Trailer
snippet.description:
Launching September 9th! Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3123060/Warlord_Awaji/

Lead a samurai invasion into the mysterious island of Awaji! Recruit, promote, and upgrade your warriors while navigating the ancient world of feudal Japan. Use samurai weapons and strategies to conquer the entire island and become Warlord!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/EnR5d2aHSW
X: https://x.com/darkmattergms
Website: https://darkmattergames.com/
